# Stale Edit Session inventory — 2026-08-09

## Scope and safety conclusion

This inventory covers every locally persisted Edit Session in `.ai/harness/edit-sessions` whose status is `open`, `dirty`, `checked`, or `check_failed` after the explicit Runtime maintenance passes on 2026-08-09. The scan is not limited by the Runtime maintenance API 500-candidate bound.

All 1,318 remaining nonterminal sessions have the same concrete blocker: their persisted metadata has no `workId`, so there is no durable WorkContract ownership evidence. Runtime maintenance must retain them fail-closed. It is unsafe to infer ownership from age, path overlap, Git history, principal fields, or session naming because doing so could discard unique source evidence or cross an active writer boundary.

Correct closeout for every listed session: establish an authoritative binding to its owning WorkContract from durable evidence; prove that Work terminal; then run the existing reconcile/cleanup path. If that evidence cannot be established, retain and report the session. Never delete the session directory or roll back source merely to make the status disappear.

## Maintenance result

- Four stale nonterminal WorkContracts were cancelled with durable evidence retained.
- Ten Work-bound stale Edit Sessions were safely reconciled: committed paths finalized, superseded paths marked superseded, and empty open sessions rolled back. The final checked session was finalized only after `package:check:type` receipt `check_receipt_c55cb76569e2b352cd867080` was bound to revision 3.
- Final explicit maintenance preview: zero safe stale Work or Edit Session candidates; 437 newest-window Edit Sessions retained for unknown ownership. This full inventory proves the complete retained set is 1,318.
